item.title: Koi Suru Kokoro to Mahou no Kotoba
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Hearts
  • 発売日: 2018-05-25
  • スコア: 7.08/10 (101 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 恋するココロと魔法のコトバ
  • 英語名: Koi Suru Kokoro to Mahou no Kotoba

あらすじ

Narumi is a second-year student at Asanoha Gakuen. One day, he headed to the Garden Club room to return something left behind by his classmate Kazane, but he inadvertently stepped on a magic circle that was drawn on the floor and summoned the spring spirit Haruharu. Since he had now found out that the Garden Club was actually a secret gathering for witches at the school, he was pressured to join the club to keep their secret. It’s the start of their time together which is slightly magical and warm like the spring sunlight.

item.title: Natsuiro Kokoro Log ~Happy Summer~
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Hearts
  • 発売日: 2017-03-24
  • スコア: 7.43/10 (64 人評価)
  • 日本語名: ナツイロココロログ～Happy Summer～
  • 英語名: Natsuiro Kokoro Log Happy Summer

あらすじ

This is the fandisc for Natsuiro Kokoro Log, featuring after stories for each of the four heroines, as well as harem routes for both the real and virtual worlds. It takes place one year after the original game as the computer research club members head to a training camp and end up helping out at a traditional Japanese café.

item.title: Natsuiro Kokoro Log
item.description:

  • ブランド: Hearts
  • 発売日: 2016-05-27
  • スコア: 7.359999999999999/10 (149 人評価)
  • 日本語名: ナツイロココロログ
  • 英語名: Natsuiro Kokoro Log

别名

  • Rorolog

あらすじ

One day, Yoshito was challenged by his senpai Kisara to a match in a fighting game. Even though he was confident in his skills, she was a top ranker and beat him handily. As a result, he had to join the cyber-research club that she was the leader of. It was a relatively new club, but it soon became lively with the addition of his osananajimi and student council deputy leader Kuon, his dependable imouto Rin and classmate Kotone.

item.title: Koi Saku Miyako ni Ai no Yakusoku o ~Annaffiare~
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Hearts
  • 発売日: 2013-07-26
  • スコア: 6.99/10 (72 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 恋咲く都に愛の約束を ～Annaffiare～
  • 英語名: Koi Saku Miyako ni Ai no Yakusoku o Annaffiare

あらすじ

In the near future in Japan, Annaffiare is a theme park located on a giant floating man-made island where dreams come true. There is also a separate ‘city’ on the island where the employees and those related to the theme park reside and go about their lives. Kazuomi was born on Annaffiare and attends a school specializing in management and administration of entertainment facilities. One day, he undergoes on-site training at the theme park and learns about the feelings of the girls, strengthening the bonds between them.

item.description:

  • ブランド: Hearts
  • 発売日: 2010-01-29
  • スコア: 6.970000000000001/10 (25 人評価)
  • 日本語名: メルクリア ～水の都に恋の花束を～
  • 英語名: Mercuria Mizu no Miyako ni Koi no Hanataba o

あらすじ

One day, Wataru, Himiko, Ai and Seishuu accidentally fall into a shining puddle on their way to school. When they put their heads our of the surface, they find that they are in another world called Imbruglia. The girl standing in front of them is actually Princess of the country. To go back to their world, they join a magic school…
